hexcraft.hextech.hex_burning_rebound.des: 35% fire damage reduction; melee attackers 40%/level chance to be set on fire for 4s; +2 Armor/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_fatal_wound.name: Fatal Wound
hexcraft.hextech.hex_fatal_wound.desc: Attacks bleed (+20%/level bleed dmg); +12%/level damage vs targets below 20% HP (execute); +0.8 Attack/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
hexcraft.hextech.hex_soul_siphon.desc: Kills heal 1.2 HP/level; regenerate 0.8 HP/level every 5s.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_rock_body.name: Rock Body
hexcraft.hextech.hex_rock_body.desc: 12%/level damage reduction at low HP; +3 armor/level, +18% knockback resistance/level
hexcraft.hextech.hex_hunter_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hexcraft.hextech.hex_hunter_mark.desc: 20%/level chance to mark targets for 3.5s (marked take more damage); +18% boss damage; +7%/level crit.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_bleed_avatar.name: Bleed Avatar
hexcraft.hextech.hex_bleed_avatar.desc: Attacks apply heavy bleed (35% x level); on kill, bleed spreads to nearby hostiles (2.5 blocks); +1.2 Attack/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_eternal_shield.name: Eternal Bulwark
hexcraft.hextech.hex_eternal_shield.desc: +0.7 absorption shield/level; at low HP gain +4.5 shield threshold and 18%/level damage reduction.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_mark_judge.name: Mark Judgement
hexcraft.hextech.hex_mark_judge.desc: 30%/level chance to mark for 3.5s; 18%/level chance to execute targets below 20% HP; kill burst damage; +40%/level crit damage.
Combat stack: +1 on hit (cap 60, decay 2/s after 4s out of combat), each stack +2% x level bonus hit damage; +0.15 Attack/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_tick_shield_gain.de: Timed stack: +1 every 5s (cap 20, expires after 30s idle), each stack grants 1 x level absorption; +0.5 Armor/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_kill_armor_fort.des: Permanent stack: +1 on kill, each stack +5% x level Armor; +0.5 Armor/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_hurt_speed_boost.de: Permanent stack: +1 when hurt, each stack +2% x level Attack Speed; +0.2%/level movement.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_perm_leech_grow.des: Permanent stack: +1 on kill, each stack +0.5 x level Max Health; +0.8%/level lifesteal.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_combat_shield_surge: Combat stack: +1 on hit (cap 40, decay 1/s after 4s), each stack +1% x level hit damage and 0.5 x level absorption.
Permanent stack: +1 on kill, each stack +2% x level Attack Damage; +0.8 Armor/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_tick_damage_wax.des: Timed stack: +1 every 5s (cap 30, expires after 30s idle), each stack +2% x level bonus hit damage.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_hurt_leech_burst.de: Combat stack: +1 when hurt (cap 30, decay 1/s after 5s), +0.4%/level lifesteal.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_kill_speed_perm.des: Permanent stack: +1 on kill, each stack +2% x level Attack Speed; +0.3%/level movement.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_perm_damage_apex.de: Permanent stack: +1 on kill, each stack +3% x level Attack Damage; +0.6 Attack/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_hurt_perm_shield.de: Permanent stack: +1 when hurt, each stack +5% x level Max Health; +0.5 Armor/level.
hexcraft.hextech.hex_combat_perm_mix.des: Permanent stacks: +1 on hit (+2% x level Attack Damage each), +1 when hurt (+3% x level Max Health each).
Timed stack: +1 every 5s (cap 40, expires after 30s idle), each stack +2% x level hit damage; +1%/level lifesteal.
hexcraft.worldhex.whx_world_combat_decay: Combat stacks decay +50% faster for all players (negative).
Combat stacks decay -30% slower for all players (positive).
hexcraft.worldhex.whx_world_timed_stack_: Timed stacks last 50% shorter for all players (negative).
message.hexcraft.bleed_apply: Bleed: target suffers damage over time!
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.permanentStackM: Global multiplier for permanent/growth stack gain speed (0.1~10, default 1.0)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.equipGoldCost: Gold equipment pick cost in coins (server-authoritative, default 2500)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.attrDisplayCap: Default 0=off. When enabled, clamps your own max health/armor/toughness to this value to prevent health-HUD mods from overflowing in high-value modpacks (yellow/red bar artifact). Display-only, does not affect damage/armor formulas
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.equipPrismaticC: Prismatic equipment pick cost in coins (server-authoritative, default 4000)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.stackDrakeMult: Permanent stack bonus per drake level (default 0.75 = +75% per level; Lv1 1.75x / Lv2 2.5x / Lv3 3.25x)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.forgeSlotMax: Max stacks of the Prismatic forge 'slot boost' entry (default 99)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.equipCountMult: Attack/armor/HP bonus coefficient per equipped item from the equip-count hex (default 1.0)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.tipEnabled: Master toggle for scrolling tip messages (random gifts, coin gains, etc.)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.tipAdjustMode: When ON, return to game and drag the tip area with your mouse to reposition it (position auto-saves on release)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.tipX: Tip area X offset (default 8; auto-written when using tipAdjustMode drag)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.tipY: Tip area Y offset (default 34; auto-written when using tipAdjustMode drag)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.hpEnabled: Hexcraft health bar (OFF by default): when ON it REPLACES the vanilla health bar - vanilla bar is hidden and a [current/max HP] box is shown at the vanilla bar position
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.hpX: Health bar X offset (0 = pinned to vanilla health bar position; non-zero for manual placement)
hexcraft.config.tip.v060.hpY: Health bar Y offset (0 = pinned to vanilla health bar position; non-zero for manual placement)
hexcraft.config.cat.dlc.tooltip: Load third-party content packs from hexworkshop_dlc/packs (core mod does not depend on them; server config is authoritative)
hexcraft.config.dlc.hint: Put packs into hexworkshop_dlc/packs (folder or zip, root must contain dlc_meta.json). Run /hexcraft reload dlc or restart to apply
hexcraft.config.dlc.code_hint: Code DLC: place the jar into the mods folder and restart the game (info only)
hexcraft.stat.hint.max_health: Max health: determines your health cap.
hexcraft.stat.hint.armor: Armor: reduces incoming damage by a percentage; more armor = more reduction.
hexcraft.stat.hint.tough: Armor toughness: reduces the loss of armor effectiveness against high burst damage.
hexcraft.stat.hint.attack_speed: Attack speed: increases melee swing speed.
hexcraft.stat.hint.luck: Luck: affects fishing, loot rolls and similar luck checks.
hexcraft.stat.hint.knockback_resistance: Knockback resistance: reduces how far you are knocked back.
hexcraft.stat.hint.attack_knockback: Knockback: your attacks knock enemies back further.
